# Preface

This site is being prepared for the 2026 EBS pollock assessment. The current
material addresses SSC comments and provides a working assessment preparation
checklist. Links to additional 2026 preparation material will be added here as
it becomes ready for review.

**September 2026 assessment developments** is the working document for material
being assembled for the September review. Its Summary is currently a
placeholder; the model-numbering plan and main October 2025 SSC comments and
responses establish the initial structure, followed by the retained 2024 SSC
comments and 2025 responses in Appendix 1.

**SSC comments** presents the responses to the October 2025 SSC comments. It
summarizes the current status of each issue, explains the model numbering plan,
and retains the earlier responses to 2024 SSC comments for reference.

**Assessment preparation checklist** lists work to review and update during
preparation of the 2026 assessment.

**Rceattle development** links to the separately maintained report on
refinements to Rceattle for EBS pollock. This is the first linked resource for
the 2026 assessment preparation.

**2025 activities** collects the three papers prepared for review meetings and
assessment research during 2025.
